blocks.zh: Section 7 Appendix II: Filtration Case Studies 附錄二：過濾再過濾案例
blocks.en: Section 7 Appendix II: Filtration Case Studies

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解過濾再過濾（refiltration）在生物製劑再處理中的監管地位，以及其與其他單元操作（如層析）的風險比較。
blocks.en: Understand the regulatory standing of refiltration in the reprocessing of biologicals, and how its risk compares with other unit operations (such as chromatography).

blocks.zh: 能區分「允許再過濾」與「不允許再過濾」的情境邊界——尤其是 bioburden 超規格與超行動限兩者的法規差異。
blocks.en: Distinguish the boundary between situations where refiltration is permitted and where it is not, especially the regulatory difference between a bioburden result that exceeds the action limit and one that exceeds the specification.

blocks.zh: 掌握 Drug Substance 主動式再過濾（Case Study 1）的驗證路徑，並能應用於 CDMO master batch record（MBR）的預授權設計。
blocks.en: Master the validation pathway for proactive drug substance refiltration (Case Study 1) and apply it to the pre-authorized design of a CDMO master batch record (MBR).

blocks.zh: 理解病毒去除過濾器（virus-removal filter）完整性測試失敗後的再過濾策略，包含小規模驗證模型與法規申報路徑。
blocks.en: Understand the refiltration strategy after a virus-removal filter fails its integrity test, including the small-scale validation model and the regulatory filing path.

blocks.zh: 能回答台灣 CDMO 最實際的場景問題：DP 充填期間 0.22 µm 過濾器 post-use integrity test 失敗，在 PIC/S Annex 1 下，能否再過濾？監管路徑為何？
blocks.en: Be able to answer the most practical scenario question for a CDMO in Taiwan: if the 0.22 µm filter fails its post-use integrity test during DP filling, can the material be refiltered under PIC/S Annex 1, and what is the regulatory pathway?

blocks.zh: 7.0 Appendix II: Case Study — Filtration 案例研究導論：過濾操作
blocks.en: 7.0 Appendix II: Case Study — Filtration (Introduction to Filtration Operations)

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Refiltration（再過濾）：指對已過濾或待過濾的批次物料，因特定失效模式（如 integrity test 失敗、bioburden 超出行動限、SU bag 洩漏）再次通過過濾器的操作。TR74 明確將其定位為低複雜度的再處理單元操作。
blocks.en: Refiltration: passing a batch of material that has already been filtered, or is waiting to be filtered, through a filter again because of a specific failure mode (such as an integrity test failure, bioburden exceeding the action limit, or an SU bag leak). TR74 positions it explicitly as a low-complexity reprocessing unit operation.

blocks.zh: Bioburden-reduction filter（生物負荷去除過濾器）：去除微生物的過濾器，常見於 DS 製程中段；其再過濾風險通常低於病毒去除過濾器。
blocks.en: Bioburden-reduction filter: a filter that removes microorganisms, commonly used in the middle of the DS process; the risk of refiltering with it is generally lower than with a virus-removal filter.

blocks.zh: Virus-reduction filter（病毒去除過濾器）：如 Planova、Viresolve 系列，用於確保病毒清除步驟。完整性測試失敗的後果更為嚴重，因為涉及 viral clearance 的驗證連貫性。
blocks.en: Virus-reduction filter: for example the Planova and Viresolve series, used to ensure the viral clearance step. The consequences of an integrity test failure are more serious because the continuity of the viral clearance validation is at stake.

blocks.zh: Viral segregation（病毒隔離）：指病毒過濾前後的物料流嚴格分開，確保 pre-filtrate 不回汙染 post-filtrate。一旦 viral segregation 遭破壞，再過濾不能解決問題。
blocks.en: Viral segregation: strict separation of the material streams before and after virus filtration, so that the pre-filtrate cannot recontaminate the post-filtrate. Once viral segregation has been compromised, refiltration cannot solve the problem.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 過濾再過濾就像廚師發現餐廳的一道高湯不夠乾淨，決定再過一次細網：若只是有少量雜質（bioburden 超行動限），再過一次完全可行；但若高湯本身已經腐敗（bioburden 超規格、或有沉澱析出），再過濾也無法救回——只能廢棄。
blocks.en: Refiltration is like a chef who finds that a restaurant stock is not clear enough and decides to pass it through a fine mesh once more. If there are only a few impurities (bioburden above the action limit), a second pass is entirely workable. But if the stock has already spoiled (bioburden above specification, or sediment has precipitated out), filtering again cannot save it, and it can only be discarded.

blocks.zh: 這個「可再過」vs「必須廢棄」的判斷，是 TR74 Section 7.0 整個框架的核心邏輯。
blocks.en: This judgment of "can be refiltered" versus "must be discarded" is the core logic of the whole framework in TR74 Section 7.0.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 決策層級（Decision Hierarchy）強化：
blocks.en: Reinforcing the decision hierarchy:

blocks.zh: Sterility Assurance（無菌保證） ← 永遠第一優先
blocks.en: Sterility assurance ← always the first priority

blocks.zh: CQA（關鍵品質屬性） ← 病人安全
blocks.en: CQA (critical quality attributes) ← patient safety

blocks.zh: Business（商業彈性） ← 產能救回
blocks.en: Business (commercial flexibility) ← recovering capacity

blocks.zh: 注意：TR74 明確指出「超出 bioburden specification」或「unexpected precipitation」或「viral segregation 遭破壞」時，reprocessing 不是選項。這就是 Sterility > CQA > Business 層級的體現——不能因為商業壓力就試圖再過濾一批已超規格的批次。
blocks.en: Note: TR74 states explicitly that when bioburden exceeds the specification, when unexpected precipitation occurs, or when viral segregation has been compromised, reprocessing is not an option. This is the hierarchy of Sterility > CQA > Business in action: commercial pressure must never lead you to try refiltering a batch that is already out of specification.

blocks.zh: 「超行動限（exceed action limit）但未超規格」vs「超規格（exceed specification）」 是法規上的關鍵分野：前者可依驗證方案進行再過濾；後者必須廢棄。(PDA TR74, Section 7.0)
blocks.en: "Exceeds the action limit but not the specification" versus "exceeds the specification" is the key regulatory dividing line: the former can be refiltered under a validated protocol; the latter must be discarded. (PDA TR74, Section 7.0)

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: TR74 指出 tangential flow filtration（切向流過濾）的再處理框架更接近層析，而非一般過濾——為什麼？這對您公司設計 TFF 再處理 SOP 有何涵義？
blocks.en: TR74 indicates that the reprocessing framework for tangential flow filtration (TFF) is closer to that of chromatography than to ordinary filtration. Why? What does this mean for how your company designs a TFF reprocessing SOP?

blocks.zh: SU bag 洩漏後的再過濾，TR74 建議需評估 filtered 與 unfiltered bulk DS 的混合（pooling）——這個設計是基於什麼風險考量？
blocks.en: For refiltration after an SU bag leak, TR74 recommends evaluating the pooling of filtered and unfiltered bulk DS. What risk consideration is this design based on?

blocks.zh: 若非含藥物的溶液（如 buffer）過濾失敗，TR74 認為再過濾通常可接受，但需評估 adsorption——請舉一例說明何種 buffer 成分最可能發生 adsorption 問題。
blocks.en: If filtration of a solution that does not contain drug (such as a buffer) fails, TR74 considers refiltration generally acceptable, but adsorption must be evaluated. Give an example of which buffer component is most likely to cause an adsorption problem.

blocks.zh: 7.1 Case Study 1: Proactive Drug Substance Refiltration 主動式藥物原料再過濾案例
blocks.en: 7.1 Case Study 1: Proactive Drug Substance Refiltration

blocks.zh: 7.1.1 Issue 問題描述
blocks.en: 7.1.1 Issue

blocks.zh: Failure Modes Analysis（失效模式分析）：製程驗證前，系統性識別各充填步驟可能發生的失效，對應 ICH Q9(R1) 的 QRM（品質風險管理）工具——FMEA（Failure Mode and Effects Analysis）。
blocks.en: Failure modes analysis: before process validation, systematically identify the failures that could occur at each filling step. This corresponds to the QRM (quality risk management) tool FMEA (Failure Mode and Effects Analysis) in ICH Q9(R1).

blocks.zh: Post-use filter-test failure（使用後過濾器測試失敗）：充填完畢後，對 sterilizing-grade filter（0.22 µm）執行 integrity test（如 bubble point 或 forward flow test），若結果不合格，代表無法確認充填全程過濾器完整性。這是無菌充填（aseptic filling）中最嚴重的失效情境之一。
blocks.en: Post-use filter-test failure: after filling is complete, an integrity test (such as bubble point or forward flow) is run on the sterilizing-grade filter (0.22 µm). A failing result means the integrity of the filter throughout filling cannot be confirmed. This is one of the most serious failure scenarios in aseptic filling.

blocks.zh: 三類失效模式對應的再過濾邏輯：
blocks.en: Refiltration logic for the three types of failure mode:

blocks.zh: 機械性失效（SU bag 洩漏、管路破損）→ 需評估是否 bioburden 或 contamination 已影響批次
blocks.en: Mechanical failure (SU bag leak, damaged tubing) → evaluate whether bioburden or contamination has affected the batch

blocks.zh: 蛋白質濃度或賦形劑超規格 → 稀釋或補加後可再過濾，屬 formulation adjustment + refiltration
blocks.en: Protein concentration or excipient out of specification → the batch can be diluted or spiked and then refiltered; this is formulation adjustment + refiltration

blocks.zh: Bioburden 超行動限但未超規格 → 可啟動預先驗證的再過濾方案
blocks.en: Bioburden above the action limit but not above the specification → a pre-validated refiltration protocol can be triggered

blocks.zh: 製藥廠在驗證充填流程前做 failure modes analysis，就像飛行員在起飛前進行模擬緊急程序訓練：不是因為相信飛機一定會出問題，而是為了讓失效發生時有明確的決策路徑，而不是臨場即興。
blocks.en: A manufacturer that performs a failure modes analysis before validating the filling process is like a pilot who practices simulated emergency procedures before takeoff: not because the plane is sure to have a problem, but so that when a failure does occur there is a clear decision path rather than improvisation on the spot.

blocks.zh: Case Study 1 的精髓在於：失效模式在批次生產之前就被識別出來，並且對應的再過濾方案提前驗證、提前納入 license。這就是「主動式（proactive）」的意義。
blocks.en: The essence of Case Study 1 is that the failure modes are identified before batch production, and the corresponding refiltration protocols are validated in advance and included in the license in advance. That is what "proactive" means.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務觀點：對於 CDMO 而言，DS 充填的 failure modes analysis 通常要在 PPQ（製程性能確認）前完成。若廠商未預先識別這三類失效模式，一旦發生 post-use integrity test failure 或 protein concentration OOS，將面臨「無預先核准再過濾方案」的困境，只能緊急進行 deviation 調查，延誤放行時程。
blocks.en: CDMO practical view: for a CDMO, the failure modes analysis for DS filling should normally be completed before PPQ (process performance qualification). If these three types of failure mode have not been identified in advance, then when a post-use integrity test failure or a protein concentration OOS occurs, the CDMO faces the problem of having no pre-approved refiltration protocol. It can only run an emergency deviation investigation, which delays release.

blocks.zh: 預先定義失效模式 → 預先驗證再過濾方案 → 納入 MBR / 法規申報，是 CDMO 在接受新客戶 DS 製程時應主動要求完成的設計步驟。(PDA TR74, Section 7.1.1)
blocks.en: Define failure modes in advance → validate the refiltration protocol in advance → include it in the MBR and regulatory filing. This is a design step a CDMO should proactively require to be completed when it takes on a new client's DS process. (PDA TR74, Section 7.1.1)

blocks.zh: 若某批次 DS 充填後發現 SU bag 破損，同時 post-use integrity test 失敗，這兩種失效模式同時發生——您如何決定是否可以對該批次物料進行再過濾？哪個失效更為決定性？
blocks.en: Suppose that after DS filling a batch is found to have a damaged SU bag and also fails its post-use integrity test. Two failure modes occur at the same time. How do you decide whether this batch can be refiltered? Which failure is more decisive?

blocks.zh: Polysorbate 80（PS80）濃度低於規格，TR74 認為可以補加後再過濾——為什麼再過濾是必要的，而不是僅補加 PS80 即可？
blocks.en: When the polysorbate 80 (PS80) concentration is below specification, TR74 considers that it can be spiked and then refiltered. Why is refiltration necessary, rather than simply adding PS80?

blocks.zh: 7.1.2 Considerations 考量要點
blocks.en: 7.1.2 Considerations

blocks.zh: Full-scale refiltration validation（全規模再過濾驗證）：與 lab-scale 模型不同，此處明確要求使用全規模（manufacturing scale）進行驗證，且每個再過濾 protocol 使用獨立批次的 DS，以避免批次間交叉干擾。
blocks.en: Full-scale refiltration validation: unlike a lab-scale model, validation here is explicitly required to be done at full scale (manufacturing scale), with a separate lot of DS used for each refiltration protocol to avoid cross-interference between lots.

blocks.zh: Preapproved protocol（預核准方案）：驗證方案必須在執行前獲得 Quality Assurance Unit 核准，確保每個失效模式均有對應的方案。這對應到 MBR 中應有「附件」或「conditional step」形式的再過濾操作指令。
blocks.en: Preapproved protocol: the validation protocol must be approved by the Quality Assurance Unit before execution, ensuring that every failure mode has a corresponding protocol. In the MBR this corresponds to refiltration instructions in the form of an "appendix" or a "conditional step".

blocks.zh: GMP stability（GMP 穩定性試驗）：再過濾後的樣品若需放上正式穩定性架，代表需要評估再過濾對保存期限（shelf life）的影響，即確認再過濾不加速降解。
blocks.en: GMP stability: if samples from after refiltration are to be placed on the formal stability program, the impact of refiltration on shelf life must be evaluated, that is, confirm that refiltration does not accelerate degradation.

blocks.zh: 「最多三批次」的設計邏輯：TR74 使用「up to three」，代表驗證批次數量需根據失效模式的數量與複雜度決定。一個 full-scale 批次對應一個失效模式的評估。若失效模式只有一種（如單純 bioburden 超行動限），一批完整驗證即可足夠。
blocks.en: The design logic of "up to three lots": TR74 uses "up to three", meaning the number of validation lots is decided by the number and complexity of the failure modes. One full-scale lot corresponds to the evaluation of one failure mode. If there is only one failure mode (such as simple bioburden above the action limit), one complete validation lot may be enough.

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境下，若客戶 DS 批次量有限（如 Phase I/II 臨床試驗物料），進行三批全規模驗證可能不切實際。此時，應在 QRM（品質風險管理）文件中記錄批次數量不足的理由，並搭配更嚴格的 release testing 作為補償措施。(PDA TR74, Section 7.1.2; ICH Q9(R1))
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, if the client's DS lot size is limited (for example Phase I/II clinical trial material), three full-scale validation lots may be impractical. In that case, the reason for the insufficient number of lots should be recorded in the QRM (quality risk management) documentation, together with stricter release testing as a compensating measure. (PDA TR74, Section 7.1.2; ICH Q9(R1))

blocks.zh: TR74 要求每個 refiltration protocol 使用「separate lot of drug substance」——為什麼不能在同一批次上重複三次再過濾來完成驗證？
blocks.en: TR74 requires each refiltration protocol to use a "separate lot of drug substance". Why can't validation be completed by repeating the refiltration three times on the same lot?

blocks.zh: 若再過濾後的 GMP stability 樣品在第 6 個月加速試驗出現降解，但 real-time stability 正常，您會如何解讀這個結果？是否影響再過濾方案的核准？
blocks.en: If a GMP stability sample taken after refiltration shows degradation in the accelerated study at month 6, but real-time stability is normal, how do you interpret this result? Does it affect approval of the refiltration protocol?

blocks.zh: 7.1.3 Resolution 結論與法規申報
blocks.en: 7.1.3 Resolution and Regulatory Filing

blocks.zh: BLA（Biologics License Application）：美國 FDA 對生物製劑的上市許可申請。對應台灣 TFDA 的「生物製劑查驗登記」。核心邏輯相同：再過濾方案需作為批准 license 的一部分預先申報，才能在臨床批次或商業批次中合法執行。
blocks.en: BLA (Biologics License Application): the US FDA marketing application for biologics. The Taiwan equivalent at TFDA is the registration and review of biological products. The core logic is the same: the refiltration protocol must be filed in advance as part of the approved license before it can be legitimately carried out on clinical or commercial batches.

blocks.zh: Hold stability（保存穩定性）：DS 或 DP 在特定保存條件下的時間穩定性數據，用於定義再過濾的最長允許時間窗口。例如，驗證顯示再過濾必須在 DS 製備後 72 小時內完成。
blocks.en: Hold stability: time-dependent stability data for DS or DP under specific storage conditions, used to define the maximum allowed time window for refiltration. For example, validation may show that refiltration must be completed within 72 hours of DS preparation.

blocks.zh: 「Only once」限制：再過濾只能執行一次——這是 TR74 明確的限制，防止多次再過濾累積品質風險。任何需要第二次再過濾的情境，應視為批次廢棄的觸發條件。
blocks.en: The "only once" limit: refiltration may be performed only once. This is an explicit TR74 limit, intended to prevent the accumulation of quality risk from repeated refiltration. Any situation that would require a second refiltration should be treated as a trigger for rejecting the batch.

blocks.zh: CDMO 關鍵實務：MBR 預授權設計
blocks.en: Key CDMO Practice: Pre-Authorized MBR Design

blocks.zh: TR74 第 7.1.3 節的監管路徑直接映射到 CDMO 的批次記錄（MBR）設計：
blocks.en: The regulatory pathway in TR74 Section 7.1.3 maps directly onto the design of the CDMO batch record (MBR):

blocks.zh: 在 MBR 中設計「Conditional Step」：以 IF/THEN 格式記錄觸發再過濾的條件（如 bioburden 超行動限、integrity test fail、OOS 蛋白質濃度）及對應操作步驟。
blocks.en: Design a "conditional step" in the MBR: record, in IF/THEN format, the conditions that trigger refiltration (such as bioburden above the action limit, integrity test failure, or protein concentration OOS) and the corresponding operating steps.

blocks.zh: QA Unit 授權欄位：MBR 的再過濾條件步驟必須包含「QA Approval Signature」欄位，確保每次執行前 QA 已書面核准，符合 21 CFR Part 11 與 PIC/S GMP Part II 的電子記錄要求。
blocks.en: QA Unit authorization field: the conditional refiltration step in the MBR must include a "QA Approval Signature" field, ensuring that QA has given written approval before each execution, consistent with the electronic record requirements of 21 CFR Part 11 and PIC/S GMP Part II.

blocks.zh: 時間窗口記錄：MBR 應記載「再過濾最晚完成時間點」（以 hold stability 驗證數據為依據），操作人員在批次記錄中填入實際執行時間戳。
blocks.en: Time window record: the MBR should state the "latest completion time for refiltration" (based on hold stability validation data), and the operator enters the actual execution timestamp in the batch record.

blocks.zh: 法規申報連結：MBR 中應有交叉參考，指向已申報的再過濾驗證報告或 CTD Module 3 的相關章節。
blocks.en: Regulatory filing link: the MBR should carry a cross-reference to the filed refiltration validation report or the relevant section of CTD Module 3.

blocks.zh: 若 MBR 未預先設計再過濾條件，一旦發生失效，只能走 deviation 報告路徑——耗時、高風險、且可能無法救回批次。(PDA TR74, Section 7.1.3)
blocks.en: If the MBR has not been designed with refiltration conditions in advance, then when a failure occurs the only route is a deviation report, which is time-consuming, high-risk, and may not save the batch. (PDA TR74, Section 7.1.3)

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 台灣 CDMO 場景（TFDA / PIC/S 框架）：
blocks.en: Taiwan CDMO scenario (TFDA / PIC/S framework):

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 正在為客戶執行 Phase III 臨床批次的 DS 充填，MBR 中沒有預先核准的再過濾條件，充填過程中發生 SU bag 微滲漏，bioburden 結果超出行動限（但未超規格）——此時能否緊急啟動再過濾？
blocks.en: A CDMO is performing DS filling of a Phase III clinical batch for a client. The MBR has no pre-approved refiltration conditions. During filling an SU bag develops a micro-leak, and the bioburden result exceeds the action limit (but not the specification). Can refiltration be started as an emergency measure?

blocks.zh: 答案：依 PIC/S Annex 1 2022 精神，不建議。 PIC/S Annex 1 2022 強調所有再處理步驟應預先定義、驗證並獲得授權（§9.37）。臨時啟動未預先核准的再過濾，屬於 unvalidated reprocessing，需走完整的 Change Control + Validation + TFDA 補充申請流程，方可在後續批次中合法使用。對於當前失效批次，需進行 full risk assessment 後由 QA 決定是否放行。
blocks.en: Answer: in the spirit of PIC/S Annex 1 2022, this is not recommended. PIC/S Annex 1 2022 stresses that all reprocessing steps should be predefined, validated and authorized (§9.37). Starting a refiltration that has not been pre-approved is unvalidated reprocessing; it must go through the full change control + validation + TFDA supplement process before it can be legitimately used for later batches. For the current failed batch, a full risk assessment is needed, after which QA decides whether it can be released.

blocks.zh: 預防方法：在接受每位新客戶 DS 製程時，CDMO 應主動要求客戶或共同完成 failure modes analysis，並在 MBR 設計階段即納入 conditional refiltration steps，後續透過 TFDA 的 Minor Amendment 路徑提前申報。
blocks.en: Preventive approach: when accepting each new client's DS process, the CDMO should proactively ask the client to carry out, or jointly carry out, the failure modes analysis, include conditional refiltration steps at the MBR design stage, and then file them in advance through the TFDA Minor Amendment pathway.

blocks.zh: 7.2 Case Study 2: Proactive Virus-Removal Refiltration 主動式病毒去除再過濾案例
blocks.en: 7.2 Case Study 2: Proactive Virus-Removal Refiltration

blocks.zh: 7.2.1 Issue 問題描述
blocks.en: 7.2.1 Issue

blocks.zh: Normal-flow virus-retentive filter（法向流病毒截留過濾器）：如 Asahi Kasei 的 Planova 系列（20N, BioEX）或 Merck Millipore 的 Viresolve Pro。這些過濾器使用 normal flow（dead-end）模式，依靠孔徑截留 parvovirus（細小病毒，~18-20 nm）。
blocks.en: Normal-flow virus-retentive filter: for example the Planova series from Asahi Kasei (20N, BioEX) or Viresolve Pro from Merck Millipore. These filters operate in normal-flow (dead-end) mode and retain parvovirus (~18-20 nm) by pore size.

blocks.zh: Post-use integrity test failure（使用後完整性測試失敗）：virus filter 在過濾完成後進行完整性測試（如 diffusion test 或 pressure hold test），若結果不符合製造商規格，代表無法確認過濾期間過濾器始終維持完整性，從而無法保證 viral clearance 驗證的連貫性。
blocks.en: Post-use integrity test failure: the virus filter undergoes an integrity test after filtration (such as a diffusion test or pressure hold test). If the result does not meet the manufacturer's specification, it cannot be confirmed that the filter remained intact throughout filtration, so the continuity of the viral clearance validation cannot be assured.

blocks.zh: Pool stability（混合池穩定性）：virus filter 的流速低、處理時間長（數小時至十數小時），再過濾進一步延長處理時間，需評估蛋白質在 load 條件下的聚集（aggregation）與降解（degradation）風險。
blocks.en: Pool stability: virus filters have low flow rates and long processing times (several hours to over ten hours), and refiltration extends the processing time further. The risk of protein aggregation and degradation under the load conditions must therefore be evaluated.

blocks.zh: Virus filter 的 post-use integrity test failure 就像飛機降落後發現機翼的某個密封件測試不過——即使飛行過程看起來一切正常，也無法確認那個密封件在全程飛行中都是完整的。
blocks.en: A virus filter post-use integrity test failure is like a pilot finding, after landing, that a seal on the wing fails its test: even if everything looked normal during the flight, it cannot be confirmed that the seal was intact for the whole flight.

blocks.zh: 對於 virus filter，這意味著：即使最終產品的病毒檢測為陰性，由於無法確認過濾器完整性，viral clearance 的法規論述（regulatory justification）存在漏洞。再過濾（使用新的完整過濾器）是補救的選項，但前提是 pool stability 允許延長處理時間。
blocks.en: For a virus filter, this means that even if the virus test on the final product is negative, the regulatory justification for viral clearance has a gap, because the integrity of the filter cannot be confirmed. Refiltration (with a new, intact filter) is a remedy, but only if pool stability allows the extended processing time.

blocks.zh: Single-use vs Reusable Virus Filter 的影響：
blocks.en: Impact of single-use vs reusable virus filters:

blocks.zh: Single-use（一次性）系統（如 Planova BioEX capsule）：過濾後直接棄置，post-use integrity test 若失敗，只需更換新過濾器進行再過濾，不涉及清洗驗證問題。
blocks.en: Single-use systems (such as the Planova BioEX capsule): discarded after filtration. If the post-use integrity test fails, a new filter simply replaces it for refiltration, with no cleaning validation issue.

blocks.zh: Reusable（可重複使用）系統（如傳統 Planova 30N 在某些設施中使用）：失效後若要再過濾，需先確認清洗是否會影響下次使用的截留性能，且需評估是否影響 viral clearance 的驗證連貫性。
blocks.en: Reusable systems (such as the traditional Planova 30N, used in some facilities): to refilter after a failure, you must first confirm whether cleaning affects the retention performance on the next use, and evaluate whether it affects the continuity of the viral clearance validation.

blocks.zh: CDMO 目前主流選擇 single-use virus filter，再過濾操作更簡單，且 viral segregation 風險更低。但更換 vendor 或 filter 型號時，需重新評估 viral clearance validation。(PDA TR74, Section 7.2.1)
blocks.en: CDMOs now mainly choose single-use virus filters, which make refiltration simpler and lower the risk to viral segregation. However, when the vendor or filter model is changed, the viral clearance validation must be reassessed. (PDA TR74, Section 7.2.1)

blocks.zh: 台灣 CDMO 關鍵問題解答
blocks.en: Answers to Key Questions for Taiwan CDMOs

blocks.zh: Q：在 DP 充填期間，0.22 µm sterilizing-grade filter 的 post-use integrity test 失敗，能否進行再過濾？台灣 PIC/S 框架下的監管路徑為何？
blocks.en: Q: If the 0.22 µm sterilizing-grade filter fails its post-use integrity test during DP filling, can the material be refiltered? What is the regulatory pathway under the PIC/S framework in Taiwan?

blocks.zh: A（依 PIC/S Annex 1 2022 與 TR74 框架）：
blocks.en: A (based on PIC/S Annex 1 2022 and the TR74 framework):

blocks.zh: 技術上「能否」：DP 最終過濾步驟（sterilizing filtration）的 integrity test 失敗，屬於無菌保證的核心問題，其再過濾比 DS 階段的 bioburden-reduction filter 更為嚴格。關鍵判斷點：
blocks.en: Technically, "can it be done": an integrity test failure at the final DP filtration step (sterilizing filtration) goes to the heart of sterility assurance, and refiltration there is more stringent than for a bioburden-reduction filter at the DS stage. The key decision points:

blocks.zh: 若批次已部分充填至 vials，無法對已充填部分執行再過濾——受影響 vials 必須廢棄。
blocks.en: If the batch has already been partly filled into vials, the filled portion cannot be refiltered, and the affected vials must be discarded.

blocks.zh: 若物料尚在 bulk 容器中未開始充填，且有預先驗證的再過濾方案，理論上可執行再過濾；但需確認 DP pool stability 允許延長操作時間。
blocks.en: If the material is still in the bulk container and filling has not started, and a pre-validated refiltration protocol exists, refiltration can in theory be performed; but it must be confirmed that DP pool stability allows the extended operating time.

blocks.zh: PIC/S Annex 1 2022 §8.86 要求：sterilizing filter 的完整性應在過濾前（PUPSIT）及過濾後均進行測試。Post-use failure 必須啟動 deviation 調查，並評估是否有任何已充填批次受影響。
blocks.en: PIC/S Annex 1 2022 §8.86 requires that the integrity of the sterilizing filter be tested both before filtration (PUPSIT) and after filtration. A post-use failure must trigger a deviation investigation and an assessment of whether any filled lots are affected.

blocks.zh: 台灣 TFDA 監管路徑：
blocks.en: TFDA regulatory pathway in Taiwan:

blocks.zh: 立即行動：啟動 deviation 報告，隔離受影響批次，通知 QA。
blocks.en: Immediate action: raise a deviation report, quarantine the affected batch, and notify QA.

blocks.zh: Root Cause Investigation：查明 integrity test 失敗原因（過濾器破損、測試程序錯誤、壓力設備問題等）。
blocks.en: Root cause investigation: determine why the integrity test failed (filter damage, test procedure error, pressure equipment problem, etc.).

blocks.zh: 若有預核准再過濾方案（已納入 CTD Module 3 並獲 TFDA 核准）：可依 MBR conditional step 執行再過濾，並記錄 QA 書面授權。
blocks.en: If a pre-approved refiltration protocol exists (already included in CTD Module 3 and approved by TFDA): refiltration can be carried out under the MBR conditional step, with written QA authorization recorded.

blocks.zh: 若無預核准方案：批次應予廢棄或扣留，不得放行，直至完成完整的 change control + validation + TFDA 補充申請。
blocks.en: If there is no pre-approved protocol: the batch should be rejected or held and must not be released until the full change control + validation + TFDA supplement is completed.

blocks.zh: TFDA 通報要求：若為商業批次且已有流向市場的疑慮，依《藥事法》第 68 條及 TFDA 藥品 GMP 管理規定，可能需要主動通報。
blocks.en: TFDA notification requirement: for a commercial batch where there is concern that product has reached the market, proactive notification may be required under Article 68 of the Pharmaceutical Affairs Act and TFDA drug GMP regulations.

blocks.zh: 底線：DP 的 integrity test failure 應在 MBR 設計階段即預先規劃——預防重於補救。(PIC/S Annex 1 2022, §8.86; PDA TR74, Section 7.2.1)
blocks.en: Bottom line: a DP integrity test failure should be planned for at the MBR design stage; prevention is better than remediation. (PIC/S Annex 1 2022, §8.86; PDA TR74, Section 7.2.1)

blocks.zh: Virus filter 的 post-use integrity test failure 與 sterilizing-grade filter（0.22 µm）的 post-use integrity test failure，兩者的監管後果有何本質差異？哪個更難補救，為什麼？
blocks.en: What is the essential difference in regulatory consequences between a post-use integrity test failure of a virus filter and that of a sterilizing-grade filter (0.22 µm)? Which is harder to remediate, and why?

blocks.zh: 若 virus filter 的 pre-use integrity test（PUPSIT 概念應用）通過，但 post-use 失敗，您如何評估充填期間的 viral clearance 是否仍然有效？
blocks.en: If the pre-use integrity test of a virus filter (applying the PUPSIT concept) passes but the post-use test fails, how do you assess whether viral clearance during filling is still valid?

blocks.zh: 7.2.2 Considerations 考量要點
blocks.en: 7.2.2 Considerations

blocks.zh: Scaled-down model（小規模模型）：使用與商業規模幾何相似（geometrically similar）的小型過濾器（通常面積比約 1:50 至 1:200），模擬商業規模的流量密度（flux）、操作壓力、與處理時間，以預測大規模製程的行為。
blocks.en: Scaled-down model: use a small filter that is geometrically similar to the commercial-scale filter (typically an area ratio of about 1:50 to 1:200), simulating the commercial-scale flux, operating pressure and processing time to predict large-scale process behavior.

blocks.zh: 兩套過濾器模擬 worst-case：再過濾需要通過兩個新的完整 virus filter，原因在於模擬最壞情況——如果第一次過濾的過濾器在使用中破損（導致 integrity test failure），則再過濾需要確保兩次完整的病毒截留，以補足第一次可能的截留損失。這是法規上「worst-case bracketing」的設計。
blocks.en: Two sets of filters to simulate the worst case: refiltration requires passing through two new, intact virus filters, in order to simulate the worst case. If the filter used in the first filtration was damaged during use (causing the integrity test failure), refiltration must ensure two complete virus retention steps to make up for any retention lost in the first pass. This is a "worst-case bracketing" design from a regulatory standpoint.

blocks.zh: 不同批次的 filtration load samples：從不同商業批次取得 virus-filtration load 樣品，確保驗證結果涵蓋批次間的天然變異（如蛋白質聚集體含量、糖基化差異），而非偶然一批次的良好性能。
blocks.en: Filtration load samples from different lots: obtain virus-filtration load samples from different commercial lots, so that the validation results cover natural lot-to-lot variation (such as aggregate content and glycosylation differences) rather than the good performance of one lot by chance.

blocks.zh: Small-scale vs Full-scale 驗證策略的選擇：
blocks.en: Choosing between small-scale and full-scale validation strategies:

blocks.zh: Case Study 1（DS bioburden 再過濾）使用 full-scale validation；Case Study 2（virus filter 再過濾）使用 small-scale validation。差異的理由：
blocks.en: Case Study 1 (DS bioburden refiltration) uses full-scale validation; Case Study 2 (virus filter refiltration) uses small-scale validation. The reasons for the difference:

blocks.zh: Virus filter 的 scaled-down model 已是業界成熟做法，因為 virus clearance 驗證本身（依 ICH Q5A）就是以 small-scale spike study 完成——再過濾的 small-scale 驗證與既有框架一致。
blocks.en: A scaled-down model of a virus filter is already mature industry practice, because virus clearance validation itself (per ICH Q5A) is done through small-scale spiking studies, so a small-scale validation of refiltration is consistent with the existing framework.

blocks.zh: DS 的 bioburden 再過濾較難用 small-scale 完整模擬充填設備（SU bag、管路幾何形狀）的機械失效情境，故選擇 full-scale。
blocks.en: For DS bioburden refiltration, it is harder to use a small-scale model to fully simulate mechanical failure scenarios of the filling equipment (SU bag, tubing geometry), so full scale was chosen.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在設計再過濾驗證計畫時，應先確認 regulatory precedent（法規前例）——若主管機關（TFDA、FDA）對特定過濾步驟已有 small-scale 接受度，不必要的 full-scale 驗證只增加成本與物料消耗。(PDA TR74, Section 7.2.2; ICH Q5A(R2))
blocks.en: When designing a refiltration validation plan, a CDMO should first confirm the regulatory precedent: if the authority (TFDA, FDA) has already accepted small-scale for a given filtration step, unnecessary full-scale validation only adds cost and material consumption. (PDA TR74, Section 7.2.2; ICH Q5A(R2))

blocks.zh: 為何 virus filter 再過濾的 small-scale 驗證需要「兩套」（two sets）新的完整過濾器，而非一套？若只用一套，代表什麼假設？
blocks.en: Why does small-scale validation of virus filter refiltration need "two sets" of new, intact filters rather than one? If only one set were used, what assumption would that represent?

blocks.zh: 在設計 small-scale model 時，如何確認您的模型能「代表」商業規模？哪些參數必須控制為相似（scaled equivalently）？
blocks.en: When designing a small-scale model, how do you confirm that your model is "representative" of commercial scale? Which parameters must be controlled to be scaled equivalently?

blocks.zh: 7.2.3 Resolution 結論與法規申報
blocks.en: 7.2.3 Resolution and Regulatory Filing

blocks.zh: 兩階段提交策略（Two-Phase Submission Strategy）：
blocks.en: Two-phase submission strategy:

blocks.zh: Phase 1 — Small-scale study 報告：在 regulatory submission 中提供小規模驗證的品質數據，作為「科學合理性」的基礎。
blocks.en: Phase 1: small-scale study report: provide the quality data from the small-scale validation in the regulatory submission as the basis for "scientific justification".

blocks.zh: Phase 2 — Full-scale validation（一批次）：確認製程規模下，再過濾對 yield、品質（純度、效價、聚集體）及穩定性無不良影響，完成後成為 license amendment 的支持數據。
blocks.en: Phase 2: full-scale validation (one lot): confirm that at process scale refiltration has no adverse effect on yield, quality (purity, potency, aggregates) or stability; once complete, it becomes supporting data for the license amendment.

blocks.zh: Amendment to the license（許可修正案）：在 FDA BLA 體系下，通常為 Prior Approval Supplement（PAS）或 CBE-30（Changes Being Effected in 30 days），取決於改變的重大程度。對 TFDA，對應「藥品查驗登記許可證變更申請」。
blocks.en: Amendment to the license: under the FDA BLA system this is usually a Prior Approval Supplement (PAS) or CBE-30 (Changes Being Effected in 30 days), depending on the significance of the change. At TFDA the equivalent is an application to change the drug registration license.

blocks.zh: Yield、Quality、Stability 三維數據要求：
blocks.en: Data requirements for yield, quality and stability:

blocks.zh: Yield（收率）：virus filter 本身已有蛋白質吸附損失（通常 5-15%），再過濾通過第二套過濾器進一步損失。Full-scale 驗證需量化累積損失，確認仍在商業可接受範圍。
blocks.en: Yield: the virus filter itself already causes protein adsorption loss (typically 5-15%), and refiltration through a second set of filters adds further loss. Full-scale validation must quantify the cumulative loss and confirm it remains commercially acceptable.

blocks.zh: Quality（品質）：聚集體（HMW species）、降解碎片（LMW species）、效價（potency）是再過濾後最需監測的 CQA。
blocks.en: Quality: aggregates (HMW species), degradation fragments (LMW species) and potency are the CQAs most in need of monitoring after refiltration.

blocks.zh: Stability（穩定性）：再過濾延長了 DS 的操作時間（hold time），需確認不影響後續放行穩定性與保存期限。
blocks.en: Stability: refiltration extends the DS handling time (hold time), so it must be confirmed that it does not affect subsequent release stability and shelf life.

blocks.zh: CDMO 在接受客戶 DS 時，若發現客戶尚未完成 virus filter refiltration 的法規申報，應在技術轉移（Tech Transfer）階段即提出，避免未來發生 integrity test failure 時無法合法補救。(PDA TR74, Section 7.2.3)
blocks.en: When a CDMO accepts a client's DS and finds that the client has not yet completed the regulatory filing for virus filter refiltration, this should be raised at the tech transfer stage, to avoid being unable to remediate legitimately if an integrity test failure occurs in the future. (PDA TR74, Section 7.2.3)

blocks.zh: CDMO 技術轉移清單（Tech Transfer Checklist）新增項目：
blocks.en: New items for the CDMO Tech Transfer Checklist:

blocks.zh: 基於 TR74 Case Study 1 與 Case Study 2 的教訓，CDMO 在接受新 DS 製程技術轉移時，應主動確認：
blocks.en: Based on the lessons of TR74 Case Study 1 and Case Study 2, when a CDMO accepts the tech transfer of a new DS process it should proactively confirm:

blocks.zh: 客戶是否已完成 DS 充填的 failure modes analysis，並識別出所有可能觸發再過濾的情境？
blocks.en: Has the client completed a failure modes analysis for DS filling and identified all scenarios that could trigger refiltration?

blocks.zh: MBR 是否已設計包含 conditional refiltration steps，且 QA 授權流程已定義？
blocks.en: Has the MBR been designed to include conditional refiltration steps, and is the QA authorization process defined?

blocks.zh: Virus filter post-use integrity test failure 的再過濾方案是否已完成 small-scale 驗證並納入 regulatory submission？
blocks.en: Has the refiltration protocol for virus filter post-use integrity test failure completed small-scale validation and been included in the regulatory submission?

blocks.zh: Refiltration 的 hold stability（時間窗口）是否已由驗證數據定義並記錄於 MBR？
blocks.en: Has the hold stability (time window) for refiltration been defined by validation data and recorded in the MBR?

blocks.zh: TFDA 的 license 中是否已包含再過濾相關的 amendment？若無，技術轉移計畫中應包含申報時程。
blocks.en: Does the TFDA license already include the refiltration-related amendment? If not, the tech transfer plan should include the filing timeline.

blocks.zh: 這份清單的目的是：將再過濾從「臨時救火措施」轉變為「預先設計的品質保護機制」，真正實現 TR74 所倡導的「proactive」精神。
blocks.en: The purpose of this checklist is to turn refiltration from an "ad hoc firefighting measure" into a "pre-designed quality protection mechanism", truly realizing the "proactive" spirit that TR74 advocates.

blocks.zh: Case Study 2 採用「small-scale study + 一批 full-scale 確認」的兩階段策略，而 Case Study 1 採用「up to three full-scale validation runs」。若您是審查員，您如何評估這兩種策略在科學嚴謹性上的等效性？
blocks.en: Case Study 2 uses a two-phase strategy of "small-scale study + one full-scale confirmation lot", whereas Case Study 1 uses "up to three full-scale validation runs". If you were a reviewer, how would you assess the equivalence of these two strategies in scientific rigor?

blocks.zh: Virus filter 再過濾後的 license amendment，若 TFDA 要求 Prior Approval（事前核准），在核准期間若實際發生 integrity test failure，您的公司應如何處理那批批次？有哪些合規選項？
blocks.en: For a license amendment for virus filter refiltration, if TFDA requires Prior Approval, how should your company handle a batch if an integrity test failure actually occurs during the approval period? What compliance options exist?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 過濾再過濾（refiltration）是再處理中相對低複雜度的操作，但需嚴格區分「可再過濾」（bioburden 超行動限）與「不可再過濾」（超規格、unexpected precipitation、viral segregation 破壞）的情境邊界。
blocks.en: Refiltration is a relatively low-complexity reprocessing operation, but the boundary must be drawn strictly between situations where it is allowed (bioburden above the action limit) and where it is not (out of specification, unexpected precipitation, compromised viral segregation).

blocks.zh: Case Study 1 的核心教訓：主動式（proactive）失效模式分析應在批次生產前完成，再過濾方案需預先驗證（full-scale，up to 3 批次），並納入 BLA/TFDA 許可為 license 的一部分，且 QA 書面核准為強制要求。
blocks.en: The core lesson of Case Study 1 is that proactive failure mode analysis should be completed before batch production; the refiltration protocol must be validated in advance (full scale, up to 3 lots) and included in the BLA/TFDA approval as part of the license, and written QA approval is mandatory.

blocks.zh: MBR 預授權設計是 CDMO 的關鍵競爭力：在 MBR 中設計 conditional refiltration steps（含觸發條件、時間窗口、QA 授權欄位），可將再過濾從「臨時 deviation」轉化為「預先核准的品質保護機制」，顯著提升批次救回率與客戶信任。
blocks.en: Pre-authorized MBR design is a key competitive strength for a CDMO: designing conditional refiltration steps in the MBR (with trigger conditions, time window and QA authorization field) turns refiltration from an "ad hoc deviation" into a "pre-approved quality protection mechanism", markedly improving batch recovery rates and client trust.

blocks.zh: Case Study 2 的核心教訓：Virus filter 的 post-use integrity test failure 是已知失效模式，可用 small-scale model（兩套新過濾器，worst-case）完成驗證，再以一批 full-scale 確認，最終透過 license amendment 取得合法授權。
blocks.en: The core lesson of Case Study 2: a virus filter post-use integrity test failure is a known failure mode that can be validated with a small-scale model (two new filter sets, worst case), then confirmed with one full-scale lot, and finally legitimately authorized through a license amendment.

blocks.zh: DP 充填的 0.22 µm filter post-use integrity test failure：依 PIC/S Annex 1 2022 §8.86，無論是否有預核准方案，均需啟動 deviation 調查，且已充填 vials 不可再過濾；只有尚在 bulk 中的物料，且有預核准方案，方可考慮再過濾。預防優於補救。
blocks.en: Post-use integrity test failure of the 0.22 µm filter in DP filling: under PIC/S Annex 1 2022 §8.86, a deviation investigation is required whether or not a pre-approved protocol exists, and vials already filled cannot be refiltered; only material still in bulk, and only where a pre-approved protocol exists, may be considered for refiltration. Prevention is better than remediation.

blocks.zh: 決策層級永遠適用：Sterility > CQA > Business——任何因商業壓力試圖對已超規格批次執行再過濾的決策，均違背此層級，必須被 QA 否決。
blocks.en: The decision hierarchy always applies: Sterility > CQA > Business. Any decision to refilter an out-of-specification batch under commercial pressure violates this hierarchy and must be vetoed by QA.
